## Where to go next

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-4}
**Learn**

The [tour](tour.qmd) builds one epidemic model, from a first run to a fitted forecast, in ten minutes. The [tutorials](tutorials.qmd) then teach Starsim step by step, through one measles model.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
**Look up a topic**

The [user guide](user_guide.qmd) covers each topic in full, from writing models to fitting them; the [API](api/index.qmd) has every class and function.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
**Adapt an example**

The [gallery](gallery.qmd) has complete models, each with its diagram, code, and result, to copy and change.
:::
:::

Also: [import a model](user_guide/building_import.qmd) from another framework, [AI tools](https://ai.starsim.org) for coding agents, [what's new](whatsnew.qmd), and [contributing](contributing/index.qmd).
